Code 57/1/1, SET-1, BIOLOGY (Theory), 3 hours, 70 marks); every ODD index 1-21 is the Hindi facing page, and the contact sheet plus full-size reads show no English overflow onto any odd page and no parity inversion. The paper is born-digital: the text layer was used as a DRAFT only and every row was checked against the full-size page (the layer drops table cells, figure labels, the en dashes in Q10/Q11, the beta in Q30(c), the raised dots in Q29 and Q21's middle line). Instruction (viii) names internal choice in Sections B, C and D only, but the paper also prints OR in all three Section E questions; seven alternatives in all (Q20, Q27, Q29(a), Q30(c), Q31, Q32, Q33), each confirmed against a bare OR in the marking scheme. Primary marks: A16 + B10 + C21 + D8 + E15 = 70. Section-A key read from the scheme text (it prints no SECTION A heading) and checked against the scheme page: CBCBCCBDDADCCADC. One CBSE void: Q30(b), 'Award 2 marks to each student'. Raised decimal dots (2·4, 8·1) in Q29's passage are written 2{\cdot}4. Quotes are straight, scientific names plain text (the Biology rules).
